resources.string: On your phone. For your family.
Test only: every link triggers a red warning, including incoming notifications.
Pause. Do not share an OTP, PIN or money. Ask someone you trust.
Warnings about links that need your attention.
Check visible SMS and WhatsApp notifications on this phone.
So a risky link can get your attention.
Allow a large warning on the lock screen. Android may show a notification instead.
Paste a test message. It follows the same scanner as a notification, without sending a message.
Messages stay on this phone and are never saved. Only the result, website name, time and warning reasons are kept.
A warning needs your attention. Open Kavach.
SMS and WhatsApp notifications are checked quietly, on this phone.
Finish setup for automatic warnings. You can also check a message yourself.
Activity could not be saved securely. Warnings still work.
Choose the access you are comfortable giving. You can change it anytime.
Access is allowed, but Android has disconnected the service. Turn access off and on to reconnect.
Only results, website names and times appear here. Message text is never saved.
Your recent checks will appear here.
Paste the message or type a website address. Nothing is opened or sent.
No known warning signs were found. Stay careful with money, passwords and OTPs.
These public examples were kept out of training. The real scanner checks them. Links are never opened.
Check incoming SMS and WhatsApp notifications.
Old activity is removed automatically. At most 500 results are kept.
Optional internet download of the domain warning list. Messages and links are never uploaded. Off by default.
The list is ready to use offline.
The update could not finish. Your existing offline protection still works.
Open Android app settings to clear storage.
This removes activity, family settings and saved preferences. Kavach will close and need setup again.
Stop. This message\nmay be a scam
Save someone you trust. You can call them from a warning screen. SMS alerts are your choice.
Keep a trusted person close when something feels wrong.
Include the country code, such as +91 for India.
I agree to an automatic, short SMS when a dangerous warning appears. My messages and website addresses are not included.
SMS charges may apply. At most one attempt every 30 minutes. Phone service is needed.
Check the phone number and try saving again.
Your choice is saved on this phone.
Ready to request a family SMS on a dangerous warning.
SMS permission is needed before an alert can be sent.
The family SMS has been requested.
The last family SMS was sent.
SMS could not be sent. Check phone service, SMS permission and the default SMS SIM.
A family SMS was already attempted recently. The 30-minute limit prevents repeats.
No calling app is available. Use the saved family number on another phone.
Hear warnings in your language. Turning this off makes alerts silent. Phone volume and Do Not Disturb still apply.
Choose the language you feel at home with. Checks and warnings work without internet.
If Android blocks notification access, open App info and review “Allow restricted settings” for Kavach.
Optional. Let a red warning cover the current app when the phone is unlocked. You can always dismiss it.
Optional. A battery exception helps Android keep notification checks connected.
Only needed if you choose automatic guardian alerts. Start by saving a trusted number.
Stop. This could be a scam. Do not share your O T P, PIN, or money. Call someone you trust.
Choose a file stored on this phone, up to 100 MB. Kavach checks its signature and APK permissions. It never installs or opens the app.
Only install apps from a source you trust. A clean check is not a guarantee of safety.

Choose a small subfolder inside Downloads. New files are checked about every 15 minutes when Android allows it. Only this folder is checked; files need a modification date. Existing files can be checked with Choose a file.
Folder access is ready. New files will be checked.
This folder could not be checked. Choose a local folder with fewer than 1,000 files and allow read access.
Agree on a private code word with your family in person. Use 4–64 characters. Only a salted hash is saved; the word cannot be shown or recovered.
Code word saved on this phone.
Use a code word with 4–64 characters.
The two entries do not match. Please try again.
The code word could not be saved. Please try again.
Hang up and call back on the saved number. Do not send money or share an OTP.
The code matches. Still hang up and call back on the saved number: a matching word alone cannot prove who is calling.
The code does not match. Hang up and call your saved family contact.
You have not set a code word yet. Hang up and call a trusted saved number.
